briefing: Markets were neutral today (NASDAQ -0.5%, S&P 500 -0.3%) with no strong risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($389.29) sits below the $500 deployment threshold, and per prior lessons we don't force a buy just to fill open slots on a neutral day — holding the current 7 positions and waiting for a genuine risk-on setup or the cash cushion to build back up.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Holding cash isn't 'doing nothing' — it's an active choice to wait for a better opportunity rather than risk capital on a low-conviction setup. On neutral days like today, keeping dry powder in reserve (even below the deployment threshold) protects against forcing trades that don't meet your criteria.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 持有現金並非「什麼都不做」，而是主動選擇等待更好的進場機會，而非在低確信度的情況下冒險投入資金。像今天這種市場方向不明的日子，保留現金儲備（即使低於部署門檻）可以避免被迫做出不符合條件的交易。

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices drifted modestly lower today with NASDAQ down 0.5% and the S&P 500 down 0.3%, a pattern consistent with a quiet, directionless session rather than any major catalyst. Without a strong risk-on or risk-off signal, institutional flows appear mixed, which is reflected in the moderate momentum scores across the screened candidate list. This kind of low-conviction chop is typically a consolidation phase rather than the start of a new trend.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢溫和偏弱，納斯達克指數下跌0.5%，標普500指數下跌0.3%，屬於缺乏明確方向的清淡交易日，並非受到重大消息面衝擊。在沒有明顯風險偏好或risk-off訊號的情況下，機構資金流向較為分歧，這也反映在篩選出的候選股動能分數普遍中等的情況上。這種低確信度的盤整走勢，通常屬於整理階段，而非新趨勢的開端。
